commits.subject: db: release the connection transaction when SharedTransaction() Commit fails
commits.body:
- SharedTransaction() unregisters its entry BEFORE the actual Commit: if the
  Commit failed (e.g. a SQLite3 deferred foreign key, or a lost connection),
  the Zeos and SQLite3 drivers restored their TransactionCount ("still
  active"), and the database transaction could stay open - nobody would ever
  close it, later statements of this connection would run within it, and the
  final Disconnect raised e.g. "You cannot use ROLLBACK in AUTOCOMMIT mode"
- now ReleaseFailedCommit() rolls back our transaction, or only releases our
  level when another transaction is still counted on the same connection
- Zeos and SQLite3 StartTransaction no longer leave TransactionCount
  incremented when the actual database call fails
- new TTestExternalDatabase.SharedTransactionCommitFailure test (fails 8/19
  without the fix)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
